Use Time: 1 Action · Range: Self (10-foot-sweep)

Scatter caltrops that turn the area into difficult terrain. Each creature entering or moving through it makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d4 piercing damage and is maimed for 1 minute (1d10 piercing instead if already maimed). Creatures proficient with ninja tools automatically succeed.

Full text: Adventures in Rokugan, p. 84.

Use Time: 1 Action · Range: Self (15-foot-wave)

Spray an irritating powder. Each creature in range makes a Dexterity saving throw or is blinded for 1 minute, and can repeat the save (Constitution) at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

Full text: Adventures in Rokugan, p. 85.

Use Time: 1 Action · Range: 30 feet

Make a multitarget ninjutsu attack against a number of creatures up to your Dexterity modifier. On a hit, a creature takes 1d6 + your Dexterity modifier piercing damage and suffers bleeding (1d4) for 1 minute.

Full text: Adventures in Rokugan, p. 85.

Use Time: 1 Action · Range: 30 feet

Detonate a smoke grenade creating a 10-foot-radius heavily obscured sphere for 2 minutes. Thrown at your feet, you may Hide as a free action. Creatures proficient with ninja tools ignore the smoke's attack penalties.

Full text: Adventures in Rokugan, p. 85.

Use Time: 1 Action · Range: Self

Coat a weapon in poison. The next successful attack forces the target to make a Constitution saving throw, taking 1d6 poison damage and the poisoned condition for 1 minute (half damage on a success). A vial holds three uses and loses potency after 4 hours.

Full text: Adventures in Rokugan, p. 85.
